entities.summary: Toni Kroos is a German former professional footballer who played as a midfielder. Regarded as one of the greatest midfielders of his generation, he was known for his vision and pinpoint precision passing. Kroos played mainly as a central midfielder and occasionally played as a defensive midfielder. Having won 34 trophies over his 17 year career, he is the second most decorated German footballer after Thomas Müller.
